approved: Superannuation (Sustaining the Superannuation Contribution Concession) Imposition Bill 2013

Supported the superannuation bills, saying the $35,000 concessional cap will benefit 171,000 Australians over 60 from July and 363,000 aged over 50 from July 2014, and that the low-income superannuation contribution of up to $500 will help 3.6 million Australians earning under $37,000, including 2.1 million women.
Superannuation (Sustaining the Superannuation Contribution Concession) Imposition Act 2013
